comment: Static engine credits and licence notices (decisions 6a-6f, 2026-10-06; docs/data-licensing.md). CreditsCatalog.merged(...) adds one credit per distinct manifest source (license + attribution) and fills the host-supplied weather entry from the host's WeatherProvider attribution. 'surfaces' says where an entry applies: app (credits screen), web (web renderer), package (world package notice and world.json credits), image (exported images). 'burnIn: true' entries are drawn onto every exported image by CreditBurnIn. 'placeholder: true' entries are pending: fill them before any public release.

credits.title: OpenStreetMap
credits.detail: Map data available under the Open Database License (ODbL 1.0).

credits.title: World data download
credits.text: The world data is a Derivative Database of OpenStreetMap and is offered free of charge under the ODbL 1.0.
credits.detail: Download link to be published before any public release.
credits.note: ODBL_OFFER_URL_PENDING: set 'url' to the static download page once it exists (docs/data-licensing.md). The offer must be live before any public release.

credits.title: Yale Bright Star Catalogue
credits.text: Stars: Yale Bright Star Catalogue, 5th rev. ed. (Hoffleit & Warren 1991), public domain.
credits.detail: The 256 brightest stars, as distributed by NASA HEASARC. Courtesy credit; no licence condition. Star names (labels only, never drawn) come from the IAU Catalog of Star Names (IAU Working Group on Star Names, Creative Commons Attribution), credited in STARS-NOTICE.md.

credits.title: USDA NAIP aerial imagery
credits.text: NAIP imagery provided by USDA Farm Service Agency
credits.detail: Measured tree-canopy shares in the regional profiles (trees.canopyShare) come from NAIP imagery, so the credit is always shown. Public domain; USDA requests this credit.

credits.title: Weather
credits.text: Weather data from the host's weather provider
credits.detail: Host-supplied: the provider mark and legal link come at runtime from the host WeatherProvider's attribution (for Apple Weather: the Apple Weather mark and the legal attribution page). Omitted when the host supplies no weather attribution.
